scripts.test:lint: docker compose config -q && docker build -t test-image .
scripts.test: docker compose up -d && sleep 10 && curl -f http://localhost:80
scripts.deploy:check: docker service ls && docker node ls
scripts.deploy:full: ssh -i <(echo "$SSH_KEY") -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@$SWARM_MANAGER_IP "cd /opt/kursach && git pull && docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.swarm.yml kursach --with-registry-auth && docker service ls"
